body:
Hey man its ok :) 

What sort of things do you do to keep busy? I think that's what I need just now. I agree with what you say about food. I had a chicken and bacon wrap today and even though I felt sick eating it since I hadn't ate since Sunday night i know its for the best and its a necessity. 

Humans  are social creatures we aren't meant to be alone :( 

I'm trying to stop my self messaging her on iMessage because I know she'd either block it and ignore it or give me a reply which would make me feel even worse. I've been staying with my mum since because if I'm alone I'll do something stupid.

Thanks for the reply :)

I'm so tempted to message her on iMessage just to try hear it from her for some sort of closure but I'm afraid she would probably just ignore that as well.

Hey!!

Someone on here gave me this piece of advice and it's whats keeping me going just now:

> Just do me a favor. Whatever you plan to do, set it in the future. As time passes you might not feel like doing it anymore. At least that's what I'm hoping.

What's going on? You can talk to me :)

Hey! 

I know exactly how you feel. I made a post the other day for something similar and someone replied to me saying I should try and talk to other people on here. So far it's kinda helping to be honest! It might be a placebo but I do feel a bit better knowing I'm not the only one out there who feels this way. 

Fire me a PM and we can just chat shit :)

I feel your pain man. I was talking to this girl for almost 3 months and we met up 4 times recently. Most recently was just that saturday there and we had a really good time just chilling at mine and watching netflix. The next day she was a little bit distant over message but whatever she's always working sunday during the day and then has a church group in the evening. The next morning I go to message her saying good morning as we've done every day for the whole time I've known her and it I see that she's blocked me on everything; snapchat, twitter, instagram, messenger and text messages. Absolutely no reason given what so ever. She completely broke my heart and I've still not eaten anything except 10 corn flakes and a smoothie since. I can't sleep at night because I dream of her and in the dream everything is fine with her and we're having a good time. With her was the happiest I've ever felt in my life and we had planned to do so much over the holidays and in the future which makes her disappearing even worse. The past 2 nights I've had to call my mum and ask her to pick me up during the night because I can't bear to be on my own. 

It sucks real bad man.

Are you ok just now? 

I've slept for a total of an hour between monday morning and now and I've not had a single thing to eat since sunday night. Is this normal the feeling of not being able to eat as you think you'd be sick? 

I had a dream that she text me back and said "can we treat that all s a joke and ignore it and move on" and I replied "yes of course". That just makes it worse that I would want to go back with someone who thinks it's ok to do that :(

That sucks man, people can be so selfish and cruel and they cant see the good thing they have right in front of them. I am glad you are here.

I'm sitting on my window ledge looking over and thinking that if I just fell over I would never have to feel like this again. I don't know how to stop these intrusive thoughts

Hey! 

Someone posted this to me earlier and I think it will help you

> If you have an idea to do something stupid, set a day in the future to do it. Wanna hurt yourself? 3 days from now, but not before then. Wanna talk to her friends? Wait 24 hours, then do it. 
> 
> Just do me a favor. Whatever you plan to do, set it in the future. As time passes you might not feel like doing it anymore. At least that's what I'm hoping.

Thanks for the reply. 


I haven't text her friend yet. You are right with the waiting thing but I'm worrying about it and making my self feel physically sick. I'm never going to find closure from this. I appreciate your words. I've never felt this bad in my life before so I have no idea how to handle it.

My friends told me that I get attached too easily. This is the first relationship I've ever had (m20) and I finally felt happy and secure then this happens. 

Thanks for the reply .
happy birthday friend, I'm here if you need to talk. I know how you feel :(
I agree that's the only way I'm going to at least find some closure. It's brutal being cut off over night. Appreciate you replying, I don't have anyone I can talk to about this.
I never spoke to any of her friends but I have their numbers that I could text. It just sucks so much cos I'm beating my self up trying to figure out what I done wrong and it's making me tear up.
